chapter: Japan trip, publishing and early influences
title: Return via Honolulu and a month on Maui; Newport Festival
summary: Gil describes the trip home through Hawaii with his family and the band members who left early for Newport.

blocks.x: I knew that they weren't making any money, but at the same time it left me with nothing. That might as well have been my profit. So anyway we did re-route our round trip ticket from see New York to Tokyo to/Honolulu on our way back at no extra cost. And we stayed there for about five hours. (LAUGHTER). (There were three but there were only two?) because the damn cab driver took us to (down 125th Street?) instead of the Queens Midtown Tunnel on the way from the airport it cost me an extra three dollars.
He said, I know where Bank and Bethune is, Or the (Rome of ?) Washington.
I thought, gee, that's great. We are riding along, and all of a sudden (unavable ?). ( ?) we had a cabin down on the beach, it was really nice.
No, on the island of Maui. We went to Honolulu first for a couple of days and....
Oh the kids must have loved it.
They did. And we got to stay there for four weeks.
Did the two (band?) fellows stay with you?
They had to fly back afterwards too because they were playing at the Newport Jazz Festival.

George Wein They called me and asked me to do it at the last minute, but I couldn't do it because I was working in Japan on July 4th. (They were there until the 7th or 8th I guess it was?) and then they came back out. We had fun there.
